label: Emmanuel College, Rev. J.A. Mackay, Principal
values: All teachers of Day Shools within Treaty Limits receive a minimum salary of $300 per annum from the Government and an addition of $12 per capita per annum for all pupils over the number of 25 up to the number of 42, making a maximum salary of $504 where they have the full average attendance of pupils namely 42. It is understood that the wsalaries above mentioned are supplemented by the different religious bodies under whose auspices the schools are conducted.
Receives a grant at the rate of $100 per annum for each pupil up to the number of 20.
